_meta.purpose: Cross-call recurring patterns the boardroom recognizes. When live audio matches a seeded pattern, the matching director can flag it with historical context. Loaded by scripts/seed_mongo.py into the patterns collection.
_meta.sourcing: Each pattern is derived from at least 2 real prior earnings calls and the actual subsequent stock price move. No invented patterns.

patterns.name: Compute capacity promise without verifiable supply chain disclosure
patterns.description: Management cites large-scale compute capacity (X thousand GPUs or X exaflops) as a forward growth signal without disclosing supplier contracts, delivery dates, or capex commitments backing it.
patterns.callout_template: Same compute-capacity language as {prior_ticker} {prior_quarter} — that one dropped {drawdown}% in 7 days against the S&P.

patterns.name: Back-half-loaded guidance
patterns.description: Management raises full-year guidance but pushes the implied beat into Q3/Q4 — classic 'back-half story' that historically resolves negatively about two-thirds of the time when accompanied by hedging language.
patterns.callout_template: Classic back-half story — last 9 times we saw this pattern, 7 resolved negatively. Median drawdown: {drawdown}% over 7 days.

patterns.name: Hedging language escalation quarter-over-quarter
patterns.description: Frequency of hedging words ('approximately', 'somewhat', 'modestly', 'near-term', 'choppy') increases ≥40% versus the prior quarter's call. Strong leading indicator of negative revision.
patterns.callout_template: Hedging-language frequency escalated vs prior call. Same pattern in {prior_ticker} {prior_quarter} preceded a {drawdown}% drop.

patterns.name: AI narrative pivot covering core business deceleration
patterns.description: Management's earnings call emphasizes AI strategy, AI products, or AI roadmap when the core business shows deceleration or guidance miss. Common cover pattern in 2023-2024.
patterns.callout_template: AI narrative pivoting while core decelerates — last seen in {prior_ticker} {prior_quarter}, stock dropped {drawdown}% in 7 days.

patterns.name: Capacity expansion as durable demand signal
patterns.description: Capex commitment AND supplier disclosure AND multi-quarter visibility cited together — signals durable demand that the market is underpricing. Bull's classic compounder identification pattern.
patterns.callout_template: Capacity-led breakout signature — last 11 instances showed median +{run}% over 7 days. {prior_ticker} {prior_quarter} ran {drawdown}%.

patterns.name: Guidance raise without hedging language
patterns.description: Management raises full-year guidance and the script is notably free of hedging modifiers. Strong positive forward indicator.
patterns.callout_template: Clean guidance raise without hedging — last 13 instances showed median +{run}% over 7 days.

patterns.name: Operating margin compression coinciding with capex acceleration
patterns.description: Operating margin guide flat or down YoY while capex grows >25% YoY. Classic 'build through the cycle' pattern that punishes near-term EPS but historically rewards if visibility holds.
patterns.callout_template: Margin-compression-plus-capex-acceleration pattern — last 9 instances had median drawdown of {drawdown}% over 7 days.

patterns.name: Late-cycle sector demand normalization
patterns.description: Sector-wide demand language shifts from 'strong' to 'normalizing' to 'softening' across three consecutive quarters. Strategist's classic late-cycle dating signal.
patterns.callout_template: Late-cycle sector normalization signature — pattern hit rate {hit_rate}% on 11 prior instances.
